newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-CRA settles Kelian mine dispute.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-CRA settles Kelian mine dispute.

text.p: CRA Ltd and Plutonic Resources Ltd said on Thursday that litigation in the Supreme Court of Victoria over RTZ-CRA's Kelian mine in Indonesia has been settled.
The two companies, speaking on behalf of the five plaintiffs, said the terms of the settlement were confidential.
"The parties will obtain orders dismissing the proceeding with no orders as to costs," they said in a statement.
"CRA has agreed to make a contribution towards the plaintiffs' costs," they said.

The case involves proceedings launched against CRA by companies associated with Plutonic and Resolute Resources Ltd, alleging CRA understated the value of the project in its successful takeover bid for Kalimantan Gold NL in 1991.
The plaintiffs said they relied on statements by CRA when they sold their shares in CRA's joint venture partner Kalimantan which held a stake in the Kelian project.
Lawyers for the plaintiffs were reported last year as saying they could seek a payout of up to A$169 million if their claim was successful.
RTZ-CRA unit RTZ-CRA Indonesia currently owns 90 percent of the Kelian mine operator PT Kelian Equatorial Mining.
Clifford said in a statement the settlement was in the best interests of all groups of shareholders and provided a basis for further constructive relations with Plutonic.
